summary: Model updated for the leader-commit move to Engine::update_progress/VecProgress; fresh traces validate; model checking found an update-introduced commit-quorum violation, reproduced on the runtime with applied-entry divergence.
validation_limits: Model checking is bounded (3 servers, small term/index/action budgets) and most BFS runs stopped at their time budget with states queued.
Trace validation uses Engine-level unit environments; async LeaderState/replication paths are exercised only by the runtime reproduction tests.
The specula CLI is not installed here; ci-result generation and persistent-finding registration were not run.

findings.title: Leader commits a joint-membership entry without a quorum of the joint configuration (VecProgress cached commit)
findings.cause: VecProgress::update raises values above the cached committed in place without re-sorting, while its prefix scan assumes they are sorted; upgrade_quorum_set orders a tied lower-id follower ahead of the leader, so after the leader's next append a later acknowledgement makes the scan accept a prefix containing a node that lacks the entry.
findings.trigger: A leader whose id is larger than a caught-up follower starts a joint membership change in which the tied pair is not a joint quorum; another follower acknowledges the joint entry before the caught-up follower does.
findings.consequence: The leader commits and applies the joint entry without a joint quorum; with 5 voters a leader elected by an old-config majority commits a different entry at that index, so two nodes apply different entries at the same index.

premises: Leader commit is decided by Leader.progress (VecProgress) via Engine::update_progress.
upgrade_quorum_set replays old quorum ids in ascending id order through update().
